title_sq: Biznes atelier per shitje te Komuna e Parisit!
description_sq:
Shitet atelier funksional dhe i pajisur plotesisht, i pershtatshem per veprimtari rrobaqepesie, dizajni apo prodhimi tekstili. Biznesi jepet me te gjitha pajisjet ekzistuese, duke mundesuar fillimin e menjehershem të aktivitetit pa investime shtese.
Perfshin:
Prese
Syzator 3fish/5fish
Makina qepese profesionale
Hekur profesional
Copa dhe materiale tekstile
Aksesore te ndryshem pune
Pajisje te tjera ndihmese..
Ideale per profesioniste ose per ata qe deshirojne te nisin biznesin e tyre ne kete fushe.
Per me shume informacion, me kontaktoni.
title_en: Business atelier for sale in Paris Municipality!
description_en: Functional and fully equipped atelier for sale, suitable for tailoring, design or textile production activities. The business is provided with all the existing equipment, enabling the immediate start of the activity without additional investments. Includes: Glasses press 3fold/5fold Professional sewing machine Professional iron Pieces and textile materials Various work accessories Other auxiliary equipment.. Ideal for professionals or for those who want to start their own business in this field. For more information, contact me.
